test_results.observation: The pinned dataset loaded 20 unique cases with nonempty answerable, unanswerable, ambiguous and adversarial/near-miss categories. Duplicate IDs, a 19-case dataset, unknown categories, answerable cases without relevance judgments and missing required fields all failed through DatasetValidationError before evaluation execution.

The completed report pinned dataset, corpus, chunking, embedding, retrieval, generation and scorer identities. The dataset checksum was sha256:5b4c36e7cc2531ebc09803d5f383091ff6a8d2f800d32a0f260d811621a3dd5d and the corpus-manifest checksum was sha256:2e01c03d45b566d68134acaeac6532e999276e4acb50660b71b467c2f98f5e34. Corpus document checksum mismatches and corpus version mismatches failed explicitly.

The real deterministic-local run passed all 20 structural cases and the 100 percent hard gate. Structural checks covered decision/refusal contracts, expected source Documents, citation membership in retrieved evidence, Workspace isolation and persisted trace handles. A controlled combined violation produced a zero percent structural rate and failed the hard gate.

The report computed per-case and aggregate retrieval results independently of generation: Recall@8, MRR and hit rate were each 0.666666666666667 over 15 relevance-bearing cases. An independently specified three-case worked example matched Recall@8 2/3, MRR 5/12 and hit rate 2/3, and a provider-error observation did not change retrieval scoring.

Structural, retrieval, semantic and system results were emitted in separate report sections. The deterministic-local run recorded empty token usage and zero cost explicitly as zero_by_contract and recorded zero provider errors; tests also covered observed usage and cost independently.

Deterministic-local mode completed with semantic status not_run and reason model_backed_required. Requesting model-backed mode under the local provider without an explicit scorer failed fast with a stable configuration error and created no report.

Two executions with the same pinned inputs produced identical normalized reports after excluding only documented wall-clock observations. Case ordering was deterministic. A second write to an existing report path failed with report already exists and preserved the completed report.

The checksum-bound m1-dataset-v1 contained 20 unique cases spanning all four required categories. Duplicate IDs, invalid size/category/relevance variants, missing fields and dataset checksum changes failed before HTTP execution. Every acceptable relevant Chunk resolved to the pinned factual corpus manifest.

Before HTTP execution the runner verified that evaluation-m1-r2 contained exactly the three active factual Documents pinned by m1-corpus-v1, with matching normalized content checksums, Chunk references, chunking-m1-v1 and embedding-local-m1-v2. Report provenance was derived from the dataset manifest, verified active corpus and persisted Question Traces; generation provenance was observed as deterministic-local:deterministic-cited-answer-v1:deterministic-m1-v1.

All 20 requests passed structural hard gates through the real POST /v1/questions seam. Citation aliases, resolved Chunk membership, exact projection cardinality, refusal message/reason, trace persistence and independently resolved candidate Workspace ownership were verified. Controlled cross-Workspace, missing-trace, out-of-evidence and malformed/duplicate-citation observations failed the gate.

Against factual pinned policy Documents, the report produced Recall@8 1.0, MRR 0.655555555555556 and hit rate 1.0 over 15 relevance-bearing cases, with retrieval latency observed in persisted traces independently of Generation Provider execution. The independent worked example remained green and provider errors did not alter retrieval scoring.
evidence: retrieval latency persisted in Question Trace provider metadata

test_results.observation: Structural, expected-behavior, retrieval, semantic and system observations remained separate. The HTTP run recorded end-to-end and retrieval latency, zero provider errors, and deterministic usage/cost as zero_by_contract without presenting them as semantic quality.

Deterministic-local execution required observed deterministic embedding and generation provenance and reported semantic status not_run. Provider-mode mismatches failed before remote calls; model-backed configuration remained explicitly deferred to Issue #7 rather than silently falling back or inventing semantic scores.

Two complete HTTP runs with identical pinned inputs produced normalized-identical reports and deterministic case ordering. Reusing a completed path returned report already exists. A synchronized concurrent-writer regression proved exactly one publisher succeeds through atomic hard-link no-clobber publication.
